pages.title: Relativity Breakdown
pages.text: The place where general relativity fails. Curvature becomes infinite and the equations stop giving answers. The fluid is cold and black, and space around it is torn. Rulers placed in it disagree with themselves, and clocks show no time at all.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)At the heart of a singularity, relativity predicts its own failure. I found a fluid where that failure was made manifest, a pool of broken spacetime.
